answer.headline: Victoria Regional (VCT) had the highest military operations share among towered Texas airports in FY2025
answer.body: Among towered airports in Texas, military share of tower operations in FY2025 ({F34.period}) is highest at Victoria Regional Airport (VCT), at {F34} ({F34.class}). In order after VCT, the next highest are Corpus Christi International Airport (CRP) at {F11}, Rick Husband Amarillo International Airport (AMA) at {F5}, Valley International Airport (HRL) at {F22}, Abilene Regional Airport (ABI) at {F1}, and Easterwood Field (CLL) at {F9}. The next airport is El Paso International (ELP) at {F17}. Every airport in the towered Texas set was scored; none were left out for missing data. These figures are a single-metric rank of a calculated share, not an investment screen and not a count of military operations.

claims.text: Victoria Regional Airport (VCT) ranks first among towered Texas airports on military share of tower operations in FY2025, at {F34} ({F34.class}).

The next highest shares are Corpus Christi International (CRP) at {F11}, Rick Husband Amarillo International (AMA) at {F5}, Valley International (HRL) at {F22}, Abilene Regional (ABI) at {F1}, and Easterwood Field (CLL) at {F9}. El Paso International (ELP) follows at {F17}.
Each share is {F34.class} as {F34.definition} over {F34.period}, from FAA ATADS tower counts.

assumptions: Towered Texas airports are the catalog group with state Texas and an ATADS tower record. No enplanement cutoff was applied.
The order is a within-set rank on military_ops_share alone, with higher share ranked higher.
limitations: ATADS counts operations at towered airports during tower hours only, for all user classes. Activity outside tower hours is not in the share.
The result is a calculated share, not military-operation volume, unmet demand, terminal capacity, fares, or profitability. Those are not measured here.
This is not an investment screen or a valuation, so there are no screening flags. Shares for VCT, CRP, AMA, HRL, ABI, CLL, and ELP all differ, so that order is not produced by a tie.
Rank scores are relative to this set. Adding or removing airports would change them. Airports without an ATADS tower record are outside the comparison.
